## Summary

Bramble Hill Dental (policy CC-1555): theft from an unattended bag of a projector and a sound bar at the insured's van, parked overnight. Declined under exclusion 7.1.

## Facts

Bramble Hill Dental reported the loss on 6 September 2026 under policy CC-1555 [notice of loss]. The loss occurred at the insured's van, parked overnight [notice of loss]. The items are a projector and a sound bar [notice of loss], [police report]. The projector is invoiced at 2,955 dollars [invoice 1] and the sound bar at 2,165 dollars [invoice 2]. The theft was reported to the police on 8 September 2026 under reference CR/2026/4195 [police report]. The items were left in a shared area and were not in a locked container [police report].

## Coverage analysis

The loss falls under clause 4.2 of the policy, which covers loss of or damage to business contents at other premises while in the insured's custody, caused by theft [policy].

Exclusion 7.1 applies. It removes cover for theft of portable equipment left unattended in a shared or public space unless it was in a locked container or locked room [policy]. The items were taken from an unattended bag, were left in a shared area, and were not in a locked container [police report], [notice of loss].

Exclusion 7.5 does not change the outcome. The police report is dated 8 September 2026, two days after the notice of loss dated 6 September 2026 [police report], [notice of loss]. The file does not state the date of the loss itself, so the seven-day period in the clause [policy] is measured here only against the notice date.

Exclusion 7.3 does not apply: the claim concerns theft, not gradual deterioration [notice of loss], [policy].

## Decision

Not covered: exclusion 7.1 applies. The claim is declined, and the insured is told why in the terms of the policy.

## Reserve

No reserve is set: the claim is declined.
